notes: Claim enrichment: 9 of 9 batches did not use a model result (2 not sent (input over the local size limit), 5 reply not accepted (WEEK2_LLM_VALIDATION_FAILED), 2 timed out); for those claims entities, factors, direction, confidence and cited source come from deterministic extraction, not from a model judgment (a direction of 'unknown' there means 'not judged', not a model answer).

Content support verification: 119 of 174 requested verifications produced an accepted model result (31 not sent (input over the local size limit), 2 reply not accepted (malformed_response), 19 reply not accepted (quote_or_data_not_found), 3 timed out); the others stay pending review -- a technical failure or a request that was never sent is not a judgment that the claim is unsupported.
Alpha classification: 2 of 870 claims have no usable classification (1 failed at the provider, 1 timed out); they are never counted as 'no Alpha'.

Structure extraction: 6 of 8 model calls contributed no edge (2 reply not accepted (WEEK2_LLM_VALIDATION_FAILED), 4 returned a valid empty result, deterministic processing used instead); extracted edges by source: model 2, deterministic grammar 0, TradingAgents canonical relations 16.
